strategies.name: VRP-gated expiry-day iron fly
strategies.description: Defined-risk short premium on the underlying's own expiry day, only when implied vol exceeds forecast realised vol (volatility risk premium). Code: opportunities/service/iron_fly.py + iron_fly_paper.py (paper engine on live quotes).

summary.headline: Sell ATM CE+PE, buy wings at ATM +- straddle price (rounded out) when IV/forecast RV >= 1.10 on expiry day.
summary.entryRules: Expiry day of the series (NIFTY Tue, SENSEX Thu), entry 09:45-10:45 IST. Gates: ATM IV / Yang-Zhang 20-day RV >= 1.10; India VIX 20th-85th percentile of 1 year and not rising; |gap| < 0.5%; price inside the noise area; no TREND/EXPANSION bias; no RBI/Budget/US CPI-FOMC event. Sell at bids, buy wings at asks; credit >= 25% of wing; charges <= 15% of credit.
summary.exitRules: Take profit at 35% of credit; stop at 50% of max loss or a 5-min spot close beyond a breakeven (ATM +- credit); time exit 14:45. Never held to expiry, no adjustments.
summary.filters: Positive-gamma or neutral regime only when GAMMA_ROUTER_ENABLED. Centred one strike toward FII bias when POSITIONING_OVERLAY_ENABLED.

references.title: SEBI FY25-FY26 F&O study (Aug 2026): prop/FPI algo entities earn 99% of profits; ~59% of index-option turnover is 0DTE
Agarwal (SSRN 2026): Nifty VRP positive on 74.9% of days, median net edge +1.131 vol pts, 1.975x left-tail asymmetry
Quantsapp NIFTY straddle-width iron fly, Oct 2025-Sep 2026 (vendor, before costs)

riskNotes: PAPER ONLY until edge_stats.promotion_verdict(): >= 200 out-of-sample trades and deflated Sharpe > 0.95 on real prices.
8 orders per round trip + 0.15% STT on sold premium: cost-sensitive; extra 2% ELM on short legs on expiry day.
Fat left tail: one bad session can erase weeks -- defined-risk wings are mandatory.

strategies.name: Noise-area intraday momentum (gamma-aware)
strategies.description: Trades WITH dealer/leveraged hedging flows: buy in the direction of a 5-min close outside the time-of-day noise area. RANGE_BREAKOUT / VWAP_PULLBACK / GAP_GO are allowed only as extra entries inside an active breakout on the same side.

summary.headline: 5-min close outside max/min(open, prev close) x (1 +- 14-day average move from open at that time) -> buy ITM option (delta 0.6-0.8) of the next series.
summary.entryRules: NOISE_BREAKOUT setup (setups.py, SETUP_POLICY CORE); 15-min trend and 1-min chart must agree; no entries before 09:45. Strike mode MOMO: delta 0.60-0.80, never the expiring series.
summary.exitRules: Point stop 0.5-1.25 x ATR5 through delta; target 4R; live trader_brain runner mode trails past target; backtest: breakeven after +1R, trail best move by 1 x ATR5 from +1.5R; flat 10 min before close.
summary.filters: Unfilled >= 0.5% gap rule; correlated-index cap; fixed-fractional 0.5% risk. With GAMMA_ROUTER_ENABLED: PE (short) side blocked in positive-gamma regime.

references.title: Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens, Hedging demand and market intraday momentum, JFE 2021
Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon, Beat the Market (noise area), 2024

riskNotes: Short side evidence is weaker (Nasdaq out-of-sample Sharpe -0.21): treat PE signals with extra caution.
Hit rate ~43%: edge comes from large winners, so never cap targets at 5-10%.

strategies.name: Late-day momentum (first half-hour predicts last)
strategies.description: When the first half-hour return and the day's return agree and price is outside the noise area, buy continuation into the close.

summary.headline: 14:30-15:05 IST: day and first-half-hour returns agree, price outside the noise area -> ITM next-series option in that direction.
summary.entryRules: LATE_DAY_MOMENTUM setup (SETUP_POLICY CORE), strike mode MOMO (delta 0.6-0.8, next series).
summary.exitRules: Same as INST_NOISE_MOMENTUM; hard flat 10 minutes before the close.
summary.filters: Whitelisted against the 14:45 no-new-entries rule; event-day nights excluded.

references.title: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou, Market intraday momentum, JFE 2018

riskNotes: Must use the next series, not the expiring one.

howItWorks.description: 14:30-15:05 agreement of first-half-hour and day returns

strategies.name: Dealer-gamma regime router (overlay)
strategies.description: Net GEX proxy from the live chain (gamma x OI x S^2 x 1%, dealers assumed opposite of the NSE client option book). Positive tercile: short premium allowed, momentum shorts blocked. Negative tercile: momentum only, no short premium. Code: opportunities/service/gamma_regime.py.

summary.headline: Overlay, not an entry: routes INST_VRP_EXPIRY_IRON_FLY and INST_NOISE_MOMENTUM by dealer-gamma tercile.
summary.entryRules: Computed every iteration and logged in diag.gamma; changes trading only when GAMMA_ROUTER_ENABLED=true.
summary.filters: Enable only after scripts/validate_gamma_regime.py shows NEG-tercile continuation > POS with t > 2 over >= 12 months of snapshots.

references.title: Cboe, Much Ado About 0DTEs (net MM 0DTE gamma 0.04-0.17% of S&P futures liquidity)

riskNotes: India has no public dealer book: the sign convention is a heuristic until validated.
US effect is small: expect a tilt, not pins.

strategies.name: FII index-futures positioning overlay
strategies.description: NSE participant-wise OI: FII index-futures long ratio (5-day smoothed) and flips to net long tilt confidence and iron-fly centring. Never an entry on its own. Code: opportunities/service/positioning.py, job 19:30 IST.

summary.headline: Bias +1 when the FII long ratio is rising above 25% or FII flips net long; -1 when falling below 15%.
summary.entryRules: Tilt only: +-5 confidence on trades with/against the bias; iron fly centred one strike toward it (when POSITIONING_OVERLAY_ENABLED).
summary.filters: Remove if the tilted engine does not beat the untilted one over 100 trades.

references.title: MarketCalls: 10 years of NSE participant OI, NIFTY after FII net-long vs net-short days

riskNotes: Vendor stand-alone FII signals lost money (L/S extreme -65.5k): filter only.

strategies.name: Scheduled-event volatility guard
strategies.description: No short premium on RBI MPC / Union Budget days or the India session after a US CPI / FOMC night. Code: opportunities/service/event_calendar.py (dates verified 11 Nov 2026; refresh quarterly).

summary.headline: Blocks short premium on scheduled macro event sessions.
summary.entryRules: event_tags(date) feeds day_context tags; iron fly eligibility rejects any EVENT_* tag.
summary.filters: Optional long-straddle event module NOT implemented (vendor evidence only, tiny samples).

riskNotes: An event missing from the calendar is not blocked: re-verify dates every quarter.

rules.name: Only institutional momentum setups are option buys
rules.conditionText: setups.SETUP_POLICY: CORE (NOISE_BREAKOUT, LATE_DAY_MOMENTUM) trade; MERGED (RANGE_BREAKOUT, VWAP_PULLBACK, GAP_GO) only inside an active same-side noise breakout; SHORT_PREMIUM_ONLY (FAILED_BREAK_RECLAIM, VWAP_BAND_REVERT, OI_WALL_REJECT) never bought; everything else DROPPED.

evidence.note: Vendor NIFTY backtests of the retail versions mostly negative before costs; own replays.

rules.name: Sell premium only with a positive volatility risk premium
rules.conditionText: Short premium requires ATM IV / Yang-Zhang 20-day realised vol >= 1.10 and India VIX between its 20th and 85th 1-year percentile.

rules.name: No short premium on scheduled macro event sessions
rules.conditionText: RBI MPC announcement, Union Budget, or the India session after a US CPI / FOMC night.

rules.name: Dealer-gamma regime routes short premium vs momentum
rules.conditionText: When GAMMA_ROUTER_ENABLED: positive-gamma tercile blocks momentum shorts; negative-gamma tercile blocks short premium.
